evaluations.evidence: As a moderator, I want to create a new game by entering a name and an optional description
evaluations.rationale: Creating a game does not impose a behavior or permission that is incompatible with any other story.

evaluations.evidence: invite estimators by giving them a URL
evaluations.rationale: Inviting via URL is compatible with other stories; no conflicting permissions or rules identified.

evaluations.evidence: start a round by entering an item in a single multi-line text field
evaluations.rationale: How a round is started/form entered does not conflict with other stories' behaviors or constraints.

evaluations.evidence: see all items we try to estimate this session
evaluations.rationale: Listing session items is compatible with other stories and does not impose incompatible rules.

evaluations.evidence: select an item to be estimated or re-estimated
evaluations.rationale: Selecting an item for estimation is not inconsistent with other stories.

evaluations.evidence: add an item to the list of items to be estimated
evaluations.rationale: Adding items does not impose incompatible constraints relative to other stories.

evaluations.evidence: edit an item in the list of items to be estimated
evaluations.rationale: Editing items is compatible with other stories' behaviors and permissions.

evaluations.evidence: delete an item from the list of items to be estimated
evaluations.rationale: Deleting an item from the session list does not impose an incompatible global rule with other stories.

evaluations.evidence: show all estimates immediately, ... even though not all estimators have given their estimate
evaluations.rationale: This permits revealing estimates before everyone has voted, which is incompatible with PP-033 requiring estimates to be shown only after all estimators have given their estimate.

evaluations.evidence: accept the average of all estimates
evaluations.rationale: Accepting the average is a decision rule and does not conflict with other stories' permissions or behaviors.

evaluations.evidence: "estimate" field filled in automatically if all estimators show the same card
evaluations.rationale: Auto-filling when all estimators show the same card is compatible with other stories (it presumes unanimity), and not inconsistent with the 'show after all have given' rule.

evaluations.evidence: enter the agreed-upon estimate
evaluations.rationale: Manual entry of the agreed estimate does not impose a rule incompatible with other stories.

evaluations.evidence: estimate a story we estimated earlier in the session again
evaluations.rationale: Re-estimating an earlier story does not conflict with any other story constraints.

evaluations.evidence: import stories from a spreadsheet
evaluations.rationale: Importing stories does not impose incompatible permissions or behaviors relative to other stories.

evaluations.evidence: copy/paste stories from a spreadsheet
evaluations.rationale: Copy/paste ingestion is compatible with the rest of the backlog.

evaluations.evidence: browse through previous games
evaluations.rationale: Browsing previous games is compatible with other stories; while deletion may remove specific games, that does not make the requirement inconsistent per se.

evaluations.evidence: view a transcript of a game
evaluations.rationale: Viewing transcripts is compatible with other stories; no conflicting storage or permission rule forces transcripts to be unavailable in all cases.

evaluations.evidence: export a transcript of a game as a HTML file
evaluations.rationale: Exporting transcripts is compatible with other stories; not inconsistent with deletion/export rules unless combined with explicit contradictory requirement.

evaluations.evidence: export a transcript of a game as a CSV file
evaluations.rationale: Same as PP-018: exporting is not inherently incompatible with other stories.

evaluations.evidence: delete a game, so that stories and estimates for this game are no longer stored
evaluations.rationale: Allowing a moderator to delete a game so its stories/estimates are no longer stored conflicts with PP-052, which requires results to be stored (non-identifiably) for research; these impose incompatible storage rules.

evaluations.evidence: create an account ... name, email address, a password and a username
evaluations.rationale: Account creation/storage of profile info does not directly conflict with other stories' behaviors or constraints (research storage can be anonymized separately).

evaluations.evidence: log in using my account name and password
evaluations.rationale: Authentication behavior is not incompatible with other stories' rules.

evaluations.evidence: change my account details
evaluations.rationale: Updating account details does not impose incompatible system behavior relative to other stories.

evaluations.evidence: delete my account, so that account information and games are no longer stored
evaluations.rationale: Deleting account and games so they are no longer stored conflicts with PP-052's requirement to store results non-identifiably for research; these impose incompatible storage policies.

evaluations.evidence: see dates and times in my local timezone
evaluations.rationale: Timezone presentation does not conflict with other stories' behaviors or permissions.

evaluations.evidence: get a password reminder by email
evaluations.rationale: Password reminder via email is not inconsistent with other stories.

evaluations.evidence: select whether to have the team estimate with {0, 1/2, 1, 2, 3, 5, 8, etc.} or {0, 1, 2, 4, 8, 16, 32, etc.}
evaluations.rationale: Choosing card set is a preference and does not conflict with other system behaviors.

evaluations.evidence: invite up to 15 estimators
evaluations.rationale: Limiting number of invited estimators does not impose a behavior incompatible with other stories.

evaluations.evidence: join a game by entering my name on the page I received the URL for
evaluations.rationale: Joining by entering a name is compatible with other stories.

evaluations.evidence: see the item we're estimating
evaluations.rationale: Displaying the item is consistent with other stories.

evaluations.evidence: see all items we will try to estimate this session
evaluations.rationale: Showing the session's item list does not conflict with other stories' behaviors.

evaluations.evidence: immediately see that an estimate has been given by a specific estimator
evaluations.rationale: Showing who has submitted (but not their values) is not directly incompatible with stories that require showing estimate values only after all have given.

evaluations.evidence: be shown all estimates at the same time after all estimators have given their estimate
evaluations.rationale: This requires estimates be revealed only after everyone has given; that is incompatible with PP-009 which permits revealing estimates immediately before all have given.

evaluations.evidence: be able to change my estimate up until the last person selects a card and all are shown
evaluations.rationale: Allowing changes until the last selection complements 'show after all have given' behavior and is not inherently incompatible with other stories.

evaluations.evidence: see each estimator's prior estimates for the story being estimated
evaluations.rationale: Displaying prior estimates is compatible with other stories; it doesn't force contradictory system behavior.

evaluations.evidence: see who gave what estimates during the current round
evaluations.rationale: Showing identities with estimates during a round is compatible with session behavior; not in direct conflict with other stories (research/anonymized storage can be handled separately).

evaluations.evidence: start a two-minute countdown timer that all participants can see
evaluations.rationale: Timer control is not incompatible with other stories' rules.

evaluations.evidence: two-minute timer reset itself as soon as we all play an estimate
evaluations.rationale: Auto-resetting the timer on all-play is compatible with other behaviors.

evaluations.evidence: scroll back through the stories and estimates from prior rounds
evaluations.rationale: Browsing prior rounds' data is consistent with other stories and not in direct conflict with deletion/export requirements.

evaluations.evidence: always have the cards in the same order across multiple draws
evaluations.rationale: Card ordering requirement does not conflict with other system behaviors.

evaluations.evidence: change my estimate as long as the draw has not been completed
evaluations.rationale: This is consistent with change-until-completion stories and does not impose incompatible constraints.

evaluations.evidence: have a small thumbnail photo displayed near where my cards are played
evaluations.rationale: Displaying thumbnails during sessions is compatible with storage/anonymization choices; no direct contradiction found.

evaluations.evidence: site which is compliant with XHTML and CSS standards
evaluations.rationale: Standards compliance is not in conflict with other stories' behaviors or permissions.

evaluations.evidence: have a list of definitions for commonly used terms
evaluations.rationale: Providing definitions does not impose conflicting system behavior.

evaluations.evidence: have created database indexes, so that the queries run as fast as possible
evaluations.rationale: Performance-related developer task does not conflict with other stories' behaviors or permissions.

evaluations.evidence: application function correctly in Internet Explorer 6 and 7, Firefox 1.5 and 2, and Safari 2
evaluations.rationale: Browser compatibility requirement is not incompatible with other stories.

evaluations.evidence: site comply with the W3C accessibility guidelines where possible
evaluations.rationale: Accessibility compliance does not impose rules conflicting with other stories.

evaluations.evidence: application respond quickly to my actions
evaluations.rationale: Performance/responsiveness requirement is compatible with other stories.

evaluations.evidence: be able to use Unicode
evaluations.rationale: Unicode support is not incompatible with other stories.

evaluations.evidence: see sensible and predictable URLs
evaluations.rationale: URL presentation preference does not conflict with other system behaviors.

evaluations.evidence: have nice error pages when something goes wrong
evaluations.rationale: Error page design is not in conflict with other stories.

evaluations.evidence: results to be stored in a non-identifiable way
evaluations.rationale: This storage requirement conflicts with PP-020 and PP-024, both of which require that games (and account games) can be deleted so stories/estimates are no longer stored—imposing incompatible storage/retention rules.

evaluations.evidence: be able to see some metrics on use of the game
evaluations.rationale: Requesting metrics does not itself conflict with other stories; storage/retention details can be implemented to satisfy both metrics and deletion/anonymization requirements unless explicitly prohibited.
